title: Pocket Fuel Black Ice Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Black Ice from Pocket Fuel is a devilishly delicious balancing act of fire and ice, with rich flavours of tart, tangy blackcurrants, the delicate spicy punch of aniseed and a cool, refreshing layer of menthol on the exhale. Sweet, complex and utterly moreish, Black Ice from Pocket Fuel isn’t just a flavour; it’s an experience. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 75VG/25PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered mods and sub-ohm tanks .
